##### Project General Facts

Ocean Point is a masterpiece of contemporary design, where the essence of sophistication is intricately woven with the serene charm of a natural setting, resulting in a truly unique lifestyle experience. This exquisite development boasts meticulously crafted residences, each nestled within a modern community that harmoniously blends luxury, convenience, and the peaceful allure of a world amidst nature's tranquillity. The residences at Ocean Point are designed to provide an elevated lifestyle, with expansive vistas that stretch out to encompass verdant landscapes, the lively pool area, and the distinct skyline of Dubai Downtown in the distance.

Residents of Ocean Point are indulged with a plethora of amenities, each carefully designed to nurture both body and mind, including community pools and state-of-the-art facilities that ensure every outdoor experience is one to remember. The development's picturesque setting, with its verdant landscapes and lively pool area, presents a striking contrast between the serene beauty of nature and the polished glamour of city life. Whether socialising or taking a moment for oneself, the tranquil atmosphere and modern amenities of Ocean Point create an ideal environment for relaxation and entertainment.

The interiors of Ocean Point feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, providing a refined and elegant living space that embodies sophistication and functionality. The equipped kitchen, with its sleek design and cutting-edge appliances, is the perfect haven for culinary enthusiasts, while the overall design aesthetic emphasis openness, light, and functionality, creating a truly exceptional living environment that is at once comfortable, stylish, and modern.


##### Location description and benefits

Rashid Yachts & Marina is a global destination that embodies the epitome of elegance and luxury, where discerning individuals can experience Dubai's vibrant scene in an environment of refined sophistication. This stunning location is designed to encapsulate the ultimate modern waterfront architecture, combining luxury residences and a full-service marina with an appealing mix of restaurants and shops, creating a truly unique and captivating atmosphere. The Marina at Rashid Yachts & Marina offers convenient, hassle-free access to Dubai, with its state-of-the-art facilities and expert, multilingual marina team providing yacht assistance around the clock.

The picturesque landscape of Rashid Yachts & Marina, with its beautiful scenery and access to exciting local hotspots, is the perfect setting for those who crave relaxation and exploration in proximity to Dubai's most exciting attractions. The marina's flexible berthing options, accommodating yachts of varying lengths, make it an ideal haven for yacht owners and enthusiasts alike, while the host of amenities and services available ensure a truly unforgettable experience. With its luxurious residential offerings, modern amenities, and stunning natural beauty, Rashid Yachts & Marina is a haven of refined living and entertainment.

Rashid Yachts & Marina is a luxurious residential haven that offers the perfect blend of modern amenities, beautiful scenery, and access to exciting local hotspots, creating a truly exceptional lifestyle experience for its residents. The location's proximity to Dubai's most iconic spots, including the rich history of Port Rashid and the commercial hub at the Dubai World Trade Centre, makes it an ideal choice for those seeking an elevated lifestyle amidst the action. With its stunning architecture, vibrant atmosphere, and unparalleled access to Dubai's most sought-after destinations, Rashid Yachts & Marina is the ultimate destination for discerning individuals who crave the very best in life.
